history.summary: IDENTITY FLAG: the CSV row name is the generic 'Durga Temple, Ghaziabad'; mapped provisionally to the well-known Mohan Nagar Durga Temple on GT Road, near Narender Mohan Hospital and Mohan Nagar metro station. Establishment is attributed to Baba Sant Nagpal ji in 1974, but one listing says 'since 1978' (conflict — verify). Dedicated to Maa Navadurga, noted for nine brass statues of Durga's nine forms, landscaped gardens and a canteen. This is distinct from seq 1087 (durga-mandir-kavi-nagar-ghaziabad), the Kavi Nagar Durga temple.

name: Durga Temple, Ghaziabad
town_description: Industrial city in western Uttar Pradesh, part of the National Capital Region on the Delhi–Meerut corridor; a major rail and road hub with Ghaziabad Junction, Delhi Metro Red Line and the RRTS linking it to Delhi.

travel.airport: Indira Gandhi International Airport, Delhi, ~40 km (verify)
travel.road: GT Road, Block B, Mohan Nagar, near Narender Mohan Hospital; Mohan Nagar metro station nearby

visitor_information.best_time: October–March; Navratri (both Chaitra and Sharad) draws the largest crowds
